_note: Interaction-coverage ratchet, read by scripts/interactions.mjs. A library with no spec is reported as UNCOVERED, not as a failure — a permanently-red command is a command nobody reads. What IS a failure is dropping below these numbers: a deleted spec, or a demo losing its only check. Raise them when you add coverage; lower them only deliberately, and say why in the commit. Raised to 6/68 on 2026-09-13 by the bigdecimal-string tab (11 cards, 70 checks), then to 7/79 the same day by the vue-write-behind tab (11 cards, 16 checks, two of them native key events); other specs landing in parallel may raise it further. Raised to 81 on 2026-09-13 by v-keyboard-navigation cards 14 (skipping) and 15 (two instances, one container selector). Raised to 82 on 2026-09-13 by v-scroll-into-view card 15 (the SIV-4 parity sweep); cards 12 and 13 gained exact-scrollTop checks in place of the +-2 tolerance that hid the 1px border defect. Raised to 8/95 on 2026-09-13 by the v-observe tab — its first browser spec (19 checks over 13 of 17 cards), every one negative-controlled. The four cards it does not reach are ticket OBS-1. Raised to 97 on 2026-09-13 by v-scroll-into-view cards 07 (cancel(), driven from code now that the disabled button is gone) and 09 (the container warnings that replaced its silence). Raised to 99 on 2026-09-14 by v-keyboard-navigation cards 16 (hover as an input, carrying the browser regression for the scroll-under-a-stationary-cursor trap) and 17 (combobox — focus never leaves the input). Raised to 9/102 on 2026-09-14 by the v-teleport-to tab — its first browser spec (7 checks over cards 02, 13 and 14), covering the TT-17/18/19 measurement family. jsdom has no layout, so its unit suite can only drive a stub of the exact thing those tickets were about; these seven are the only checks in the repo that can see the defect at all. The eleven cards it does not reach are placement, sizing, arrow and observer behaviour the owner confirmed working from the deployed site, and they stay uncovered deliberately rather than by omission. Raised to 10/109 on 2026-09-14 by the v-fit-children tab — its first browser spec (12 checks over 7 of 11 cards, including the two new event-contract cards 10 and 11). FIT-1's F1 and F2 and the quality audit's dispatch-gate finding are all invisible to `pnpm geometry`, which measures children spilling PAST the host and reports overflowPx 0 for a row that hid every child; these checks read the payload a listener received out of the card's own output instead. Negative-control the whole file with PLAYGROUND_UNALIAS=v-fit-children, which resolves the tab to the published 2.2.0 in node_modules: the five F1/F2/quality-1 checks fail there. Raised to 111 on 2026-09-14 by v-copy cards 16 and 17 (COPY-5, the user's own selection): ten checks that drag a REAL selection with Input.dispatchMouseEvent, press a real trigger and read the real clipboard back over a primed sentinel. Every positive assertion is primed with a sentinel first, because the system clipboard outlives a page load and an earlier check's value would otherwise pass for a copy that never happened. Raised to 114 on 2026-09-14 by the v-teleport-to tab's TT-22 repair: cards 05, 09 and 11 gained their first checks and card 02 gained a second. Card 11 is the important one — it was the ONLY card in that tab with no check, and its old shape (content always rendered, reference never moves) could not have expressed the composable's P0 even with one, which is exactly why a blind certifier found the defect and 836 green jsdom declarations did not. Its three checks all go red against 1.1.0's `flush: 'sync'`. Card 13's new native check drives the same content sweep at three window heights, because its headline claim was previously only reproducible on a short window. Raised to 116 on 2026-09-14 by the v-scroll-into-view tab (SIV-6): card 16 is a new direction sweep — the horizontal counterpart to card 15 — with five checks, and card 05 gains its first, a native check asserting that a correctly configured chat pane which is not full yet produces no console warning at page load. Card 15's 192 rows are vertical-only with `inline` pinned to 'nearest', so nothing in this repo could see the direction defect the blind certifier found in the published 1.3.0. Negative-control the lot with `pnpm interactions:dist` over the 1.3.0 artifact: 22 of card 16's 36 rows disagree with native there, card 09 reports 1 warning where 6 elements are broken, and card 05's check fires on the false alarm that used to spend the global warning latch.
